key.name: autohide
key.summary: Hide the dock until the pointer pushes against the bottom edge

key.name: intellihide
key.summary: While auto-hiding, stay visible as long as no window overlaps the dock

key.name: hide-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before hiding once the pointer leaves

key.name: pressure-threshold
key.summary: How hard to push against the bottom edge to show the dock (pixels of pointer travel)

key.name: background
key.summary: Background colour: black or white from the colour scheme, the palette accent, or background-color

key.name: background-color
key.summary: The dock's own colour (#rrggbb) when background is custom (carried over from Dash to Dock)

key.name: click-action
key.summary: Clicking a running app's icon: switch to it, and when it's already in front, minimize it (one window) or go to its next window (several)

key.name: indicator
key.summary: Running indicator: one dot per window (up to 4), a single dot, or none

key.name: previews
key.summary: Show the app's windows above its icon after hovering over it

key.name: badges
key.summary: Show apps' unread counts and progress on their icons (the Unity launcher API Firefox, Thunderbird and Telegram use)

key.name: show-apps-at-start
key.summary: Put the Show Apps button at the start of the dock instead of the end

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Which monitor the dock is on (-1: the primary one)

key.name: edge-gap
key.summary: Gap between the dock and the bottom edge, in pixels (a floating dock)

key.name: hidden-app-prefixes
key.summary: App IDs starting with these are never shown as running in the dock (the web-app drawer)
